Why Track Your Emotions?

Awareness is the first coping skill

  • Gain emotional awareness: notice patterns and triggers such as sleep, food, or people.
  • Manage stress and anxiety: see how habits like journaling or exercise change how you feel.
  • Prepare for check-ins with a therapist, a doctor, or yourself.

Exploring Plutchik’s Wheel of Emotions

  • Emotional intelligence: recognize and manage your own emotions and those of others.
  • Clearer communication: name and express what you feel.
  • Better relationships: more empathy and attunement to others’ needs.
  • Stress management: understand the sources of your emotions.
  • Conflict resolution: address the emotions underneath a disagreement.

This tool supports self-awareness and is not a substitute for professional care.
